rules: .swf { animation: 0.45s ease 0s 1 normal none running swf; }
.sw { display: inline-grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; position: relative; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 980px; padding: 1px; view-transition-name: sw; }

.sw::before { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 1px; bottom: 1px; left: 1px; width: calc(50% - 1px); background: var(--ink); border-radius: 980px; transition: transform 0.38s cubic-bezier(0.3, 0.8, 0.2, 1); }

.sw button { position: relative; z-index: 1; justify-content: center; transition: color 0.3s; border: 0px; background: none; font: 600 11px var(--sans); color: var(--ink3); padding: 1px 9px; border-radius: 980px; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; }
